episodeTitle.en: Business strategy with Hamilton Helmer (author of 7 Powers)
episodeTitle.zh: 与汉密尔顿·赫尔默（《7种战略力量》作者）的商业战略对话

guestBioOfficial.en: Hamilton Helmer is one of the world’s leading experts on business strategy and the author of the seminal book 7 Powers: The Foundations of Business Strategy, which provides a comprehensive framework for understanding what it really takes to achieve and sustain a competitive advantage. With more than three decades of experience in the strategic consulting industry, Hamilton has advised over 200 companies—from burgeoning startups to Fortune 100 giants—on how to identify, build, and leverage their unique strategic powers. In our conversation, we discuss: • Potential sources of power that startups should develop from an early stage
guestBioOfficial.zh: 汉密尔顿·赫尔默是全球顶尖的商业战略专家，也是开创性著作《7种战略力量：商业战略基础》的作者。该书为理解如何真正获得并维持竞争优势提供了全面的框架。凭借在战略咨询行业超过30年的经验，汉密尔顿曾为200多家公司提供咨询服务——从初创企业到《财富》100强巨头——帮助他们识别、构建并利用独特的战略力量。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：• 初创企业应从早期阶段就开发的潜在力量来源

title.en: Business strategy with Hamilton Helmer (author of 7 Powers)
title.zh: 与汉密尔顿·赫尔默（《7种战略力量》作者）的商业战略对话

summary.en: Hamilton explains that real 'power' requires both a benefit and a barrier—speed or a great team alone is a treadmill, not a moat—and walks through how startups can begin developing sources of power early. He covers which powers companies mistakenly think they have, how power relates to strategy and moats, and what individual PMs (not just leaders) can do with these insights. The conversation also explores how AI is reshaping both market entry and the classic sources of power, plus a preview of his next book.
summary.zh: Hamilton 解释说，真正的“力量”需要同时具备收益与壁垒——光有速度或优秀团队只是 treadmill（跑步机），而非护城河，并讲解了初创公司如何尽早开始培育力量来源。他谈到了公司常误以为自己拥有、实则没有的力量，力量如何与战略和护城河关联，以及普通 PM（不只是领导者）能如何利用这些洞见。对话还探讨了 AI 如何重塑市场进入方式与经典力量来源，并预告了他的下一本书。
